text:
zoe (Sales Ops): Heads-up: CatalystWorks filed a dispute on INV-2026-0830 claiming 3rd-party partner traffic was billed to them. They're requesting a 35% retro credit on the overage line and a one-off Net90 payment term. Claire escalated.
claire (Account Exec): Quick context: they had a Dedicated migration; partner connector misattributed 420k tokens in July -> overage line = $85,000. Customer asks 35% (~$29,750) + Net90 citing cashflow while they reconcile partner billing. They say they will push future committed spend if we resolve.
mahesh (RevOps): Uploaded usage audit, partner mapping csv, and ingestion logs to BILL-4802. Preliminary analysis: about 58% of disputed usage came from the partner connector. We can pursue partner recovery, but that takes ~30 days.
ivan (Finance): Policy: manager approval for credits <= $20k; Sr Finance for (20k,100k]; CFO for >100k. Payment terms > Net60 require VP Finance signoff. Also need tax impact note (sales tax reclamation) and journal entries. If we do a full one-time concession we need to decide GL hit vs. deferred revenue adjustment.
zoe (Sales Ops): My recommendation: offer a 25% one-time credit ($21,250) + Net60 (not Net90), contingent on: 1) signed amendment locking a 6-month minimum, 2) explicit partner-cost-recovery plan (we open recovery case), and 3) reseller commission recalculation clause. This keeps concession under Sr Finance threshold and preserves working capital.
sophie (Legal): I can draft: a short amendment capturing the credit amount, Net60 exception, and commit. Also a partner acknowledgement template and a clause that the credit is "one-time, non-precedent". Need final numbers to populate.
mahesh (RevOps): Action items I'm tracking: 1) Confirm final credit amt 2) Legal amendment draft 3) NetSuite credit memo placeholder 4) Finance approval 5) Post after signed amendment. Created ticket BILL-4802 and attached docs.
accounting-bot: Automated: NetSuite CM template BILL-4802-CM created (status: draft). Link: https://ns.internal/redwood/BILL-4802-CM
ivan (Finance): Provisional: I can approve up to $22k and Net60 if amendment and partner recovery plan are attached before posting. If final concession > $22k, escalate to Sr Finance (approval queue). Also request explicit journal entry suggestion: Debit Revenue-Adj, Credit AR for the one-time CM; include tax reversal if applicable.
claire (Account Exec): Customer verbally agreed to 25% + Net60 + 6-month commit in principle. I will get the signed amendment today. Can someone own the partner recovery case and timeline?
mahesh (RevOps): I'll open the partner recovery ticket and cc finance. We'll provide expected recovery percent and ETA.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk route started for thread 1865432100. Outstanding approvals: Legal amendment signoff, Finance final confirmation if concession > $22k. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1865432100
zoe (Sales Ops): To confirm closing criteria: signed amendment uploaded to BILL-4802; partner recovery case initiated with evidence; NetSuite CM posted. Once posted we'll capture commission recalc and update revenue ops.
ivan (Finance): :white_check_mark: Provisional approval for $21,250 concession pending signed amendment and partner plan. Finance will post in the current close period once docs are attached. If partner recovery comes through, we'll net that in the next month.
claire (Account Exec): I'll upload the signed amendment and the customer's acknowledgement once I have it from legal. Thanks team.
zoe (Sales Ops): Thanks all — tagging for audit trail.
